items.title: Christa Pike 'angry and confused' after failed execution, lawyers say
items.summary: Lawyers say the convicted killer was surprised to have survived and remained "shackled" to her hospital bed.

items.title: Watch: What we know about Christa Pike's ‘shock’ recovery in hospital
items.summary: The US death row inmate's legal team said at a press conference that she is now "conscious and speaking" after her failed execution.

items.title: Burnham to hold security talks with German chancellor in Berlin
items.summary: Downing Street said deeper co-operation in the face of rising hybrid threats from Russia would be high on the agenda during Burnham's first official visit to Germany.

items.title: Spanish pensioner whose eviction sparked nationwide protests dies, union says
items.summary: Maricarmen Abascal, 87, was forcibly removed on a stretcher from her apartment of more than 70 years in September.

items.title: We spent thousands on a Tui river cruise but ended up on coach trips
items.summary: Passengers have described their anger after their itineraries changed to involve hours spent on coach trips instead.

items.title: Israelis demand accountability over 7 October failures three years after attacks
items.summary: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has refused to take any personal responsibility for what happened or order a state inquiry.

items.title: Former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro expected to face more charges this week
items.summary: The new charges are expected to accuse Maduro and his wife of playing a role in the torture of Americans in Venezuelan prisons, US media reports.

items.title: Badenoch says Tories would scrap inheritance tax on family homes
items.summary: Tory leader says her party is "coming back", as she aims to convince voters it has changed after 2024 election defeat.
